blocks.title: Understand the CPU areas
blocks.text: The control unit decodes and coordinates operations; the ALU performs arithmetic and logical operations.

blocks.title: Separate address from data
blocks.text: MAR holds the address being accessed; MDR holds the instruction or data transferred; PC holds the next instruction's address.

blocks.title: Trace the simplified fetch
blocks.text: With PC=120, MAR becomes 120; memory supplies instruction via MDR to CIR; PC advances to the next sequential address. Branching may change PC later.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict first
blocks.text: Copy PC=50 into MAR to identify the memory address being accessed.

blocks.title: Worked example · Explain the answer
blocks.text: Fetch memory content into MDR, copy it to CIR and advance PC to 51.
